summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Task Manager -> To-dos date bar and inline TaskDarPanel. All acceptance criteria passed. Login as exec.test worked, date bar shows Today pill, prev/next flippers shift by one day, native date input jumps to any date, Jump-to-today reappears when off today. Day-view filtering verified: today shows checklist item ('Open the boat shed and log the keys'), 2026-12-01 shows 'Renew insurance' + 2 checklist items with violet 'Checklist' pill. DAR panel hidden on scope=Everyone; visible on scope=Mine with 'My DAR · <date>' header, textarea, File-DAR button disabled at 0 chars and enabled after 47 chars. Filing succeeded, panel switched to 'Update DAR' with Share button. On future date (2026-12-01) the panel shows task-dar-future read-only message. Returning to today shows 'Update DAR' (existing DAR re-loaded).
critical_code_review_comments: TaskDarPanel.jsx: In save() success handler, prefer setText(res.text) unconditionally over `res.text || text` to reflect any server-side trimming/normalisation.

TodosTab.jsx line 104: date input onChange guards on truthy value which prevents users from clearing the input (fine here) but native date pickers occasionally emit empty strings when typing; consider ignoring silently as done — acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Created one real DAR record for exec.test on server today (2026-09-11) via the UI as expected per request. Text: 'Testing DAR filing via automation script iter62.'
context_for_next_testing_agent: New UI paths all use data-testid: todo-date-bar/prev/next/today/input/label, todo-scope-mine, task-dar-panel/loading/text/save/future. Server 'today' from /todos is 2026-09-11. Future to-do 'Renew insurance' is due 2026-12-01. Filing a DAR persists real data for exec.test.
